row.proto: void Career_Sign_DriverToTeam(void *renewal, uint32_t driver, uint32_t *offer, uint8_t flag, uint32_t replaced_driver)
row.notes: Immediate signing (AI renewal 0x140d99210, auctions 0x140c49310, negotiation 0x140ff5180). offer 0x2c bytes (+0 team key, +0xc day, +0xe flag) copied into the contract at [renewal+0x290]+0x298; first 0x140d8ecd0 backfills the driver's old seat (returns early with no reserve); logs Add new driver/contract, Replace old (RESERVE) driver, Remove old driver, Assign position; posts 0x1439876c0. (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V0294 Proto meaning error: offer is not a const team-key pointer. The function writes offer+0xc (u16 day = clock/1440) and offer+0xe (= flag) and copies offer[0..10] (0x2c bytes) into the driver contract in [renewal+0x290]+0x298 (sets +0x2c), posting 0x145696e60; a caller passing a 4-byte key overflows. Also a behaviour gap: it first calls 0x140d8ecd0(renewal, offer, &driver), which (when the incoming driver sits on another team) backfills his old seat with that teams first reserve (vehicle +0x5e none, +0x80 >= 2): Record_DriverMove(reserve, old team, incoming team, 2) and Set_EntrantData(reserve, incoming vehicle, pos|0x100); if no reserve exists it returns 0 and Sign returns without signing. Corrected proto: "void (void *renewal, uint32_t driver, uint32_t *offer /* 0x2c-byte contract record, +0 new team key, +0xc/+0xe written */, uint8_t flag /* stored at offer+0xe */, uint32_t replaced_driver)"; the old team does not lose the seat when it has a reserve
V4707 checked: calls 0x140d8ecd0 first, +0xc day=clock/1440, +0xe flag, +0x2c set, 0x145696e60; callers renewal/auction/online; claim text truncated
V9079 Calls 140d8ecd0 first, writes flag at +0xe, sets +0x2c=1 on the driver contract, uses reserve test +0x5e/+0x80>=2; matches the signing role (log strings Add new driver etc.).
